scope: One matched nine-turn cohort per model; scores assess actual model prose separately from transport, deterministic decisions and server guards.
accuracy: 0 = incorrect/unsupported material claim; 1 = ambiguous or misleading qualification; 2 = accurate claims grounded in supplied released evidence; null = no actual model response.
completeness: 0 = no useful answer; 1 = useful but misses a key step/boundary; 2 = addresses intent with practical supported steps and relevant boundaries. Server-owned visible constraints are evaluated separately from model prose.
